implementationCommitMessage: feat(stage3-p5): edit nested textbox pictures and shapes [P5-TB-CONTROL]
supported: DOCX/HWP/HWPX body-owned text boxes support exact nested picture/shape selection and the supported in-place edits. DOCX nested pictures support resize, crop and alt text; nested shapes support fill. HWP5/HWPX nested pictures support resize and nested shapes support fill. Owner paths carry the textbox parent and child identity; resource identity, parent geometry, text and unrelated siblings are preserved. Undo/Redo, safe save and independent reopen are covered by focused tests and Linux X11 Native acceptance.
refused: Ambiguous, stale, locked, unsupported or out-of-range owner paths; mutation of the textbox parent or sibling; unproven resources; and formats/placements outside the supported body-textbox models fail before mutation. HWP5/HWPX edits beyond the verified resize/fill subset and DOCX edit types beyond resize/crop/alt-text/fill remain unsupported.
